newsitem.title: DENMARK: FORECAST - Danish Feb CPI seen at lower 2.4 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Danish Feb CPI seen at lower 2.4 pct y/y.

text.p: Denmark's consumer prices were seen falling to an average year-on-year 2.4 percent in February from January's 2.7 percent, according to 15 analysts polled by Reuters on Wednesday.
The forecast was based on the national method of calculation and no estimates were made using the European Union's harmonised formula.
The estimates fell within a 2.3-2.6 percent range.
The Danish national statistics office issues its February 1997 data using both the national and EU methods on Friday March 21 at 0830 gmt.
